boundaries: One macOS arm64 host; ordinary desktop load; no OS cache flush.
All scheduled samples retained; median from seven measured repetitions.
Embedded Monty only. Public check output timing and internal research project timing are separate.
Editor timing is companion-only; the pinned reference fork fails its warm revision sequence, as documented in historical evidence.
No assertion of universal performance optimality or a new V8/V11 controlled speedup.

editor.method: Persistent companion server; three warmup edits then seven measured edits per kind; diagnostics verified after every edit. The pinned fork is not timed in this run.
editor.warmup_timer_note: Three warmup edits per kind are retained in request/server timings; only measured edits retain the separate notify-through-diagnostic elapsed value.

method.first_observed: recorded separately; no OS cache flush, so not evidence of physically cold disk caches
method.order: backend order rotates across rounds and workloads
method.processes: fresh companion and checker per invocation; push reuses the checker within that invocation only
method.timer: perf_counter around subprocess.run; includes startup, subprocess output capture, and all Rust projection/checking; excludes input preparation, verification and evidence writes
method.warmup: discarded from summary but fully verified; only OS/filesystem caches can survive across invocations
